prompt_en: Photograph a photorealistic full-body civic-technology editorial of one clearly adult woman, age 28, at a flood-resilient underground maglev transfer platform during an emergency drill. She calibrates an emergency gyroscopic platform beacon while amber rings activate above wet basalt tiles. Her fully opaque graphite utility coverall, reflective piping, gloves, and armored ankle boots suit the work. Her facial appearance draws only from the attached reference: softly oval face, almond-shaped brown eyes, straight dark brows, natural rose lips, and long center-parted dark waves. Show frontal-plane pelvic obliquity under single-leg support: her entire weight is borne by the straight left leg while the pelvis tilts laterally, making the hip points visibly unequal in height. Show staggered leg depth separation: her right leg trails backward in depth with the whole right boot lifted just above the floor. Show head-shoulder opposition: her shoulders angle left toward the beacon while her head turns right toward an arriving capsule. Use a level, knee-height, head-to-toe vertical frame with both boots entirely visible and unobscured. Cool ceiling panels balance the amber beacon glow across her coverall.
